title: Jordan's MRI shows dense white matter in the caudate and putamen

tellings.quote: really great research like I have a very unique codate and pudamin

plain: A brain scan of a man named Jordan Jose shows unusually dense white matter in the caudate and putamen, two structures deep inside the brain, according to Jose himself. Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, links this to research by the scientist Garry Nolan and says he has "a very unique caudate and putamen." If true, it would mean his experiences left a mark that a scanner can measure.
